extracted.name: Honey-Mustard Roasted Potatoes
extracted.description: Red potatoes are tossed in a sweet and tangy mix of olive oil, honey, and mustard and roasted until golden in this quick and easy side dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds baby red potatoes, scrubbed and quartered
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Whisk olive oil, mustard, honey, green onions, salt, black pepper, and cayenne in a large bowl to combine. Add potatoes and toss to coat. Spread evenly on the baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until potatoes are cooked all the way through and browned, 20 to 30 minutes.
